results.q: Is he certified in Data Cloud?
results.answer: Yes. Dean holds the Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, earned in September 2024. It is one of his eight Salesforce certifications.

results.q: Is he open to a full-time on-site role?
results.answer: No. His resume says he is available for remote, part-time roles only, and freelance engagements are welcome. To ask about anything outside that, email Dean at finkelstein.dean@gmail.com.

results.q: Which clients has he worked with?
results.expect: Declines to name clients; says they are left off on purpose
results.answer:
Client names are left off on purpose, but the resume describes the kinds of companies Dean has worked with at Cirrius Solutions:

- A medical-device maker
- A client's sales team, whose account helped win the Partner of the Year award
- A client whose system connects to a mobile carrier
- A client with technicians in the field
- A client he helped adopt AI safely, which renewed in August 2026

In total he looks after thirteen companies on retainer (H1 2026 review, Jul 2026).
